headline: Methuen Cultural Council reviews Methuen Day feedback and begins FY27 grant voting process.
summary: The council will get a financial update, review Methuen Day feedback and surveys, and start reviewing FY27 grants to begin the voting process. The Engagement and Outreach Subcommittee will also give a report.
items: Begin looking at FY27 Grants to start the process of voting
